partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks.  Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Identify the fundamental aspects of forensic Engineering
Apply forensic Engineering in Practical work flow and Investigation
Apply methods and analysis in Forensic Investigation
Develop practical strategies and standards of Investigation
Create an awareness in criminal cases and create Engineering expertise in court room on forensic Engineering
